reviews.title: Awesome headset, absolutely love it.
reviews.comment:
I bought this headset along with my PC back in 2024, and I still use it almost daily. Here are my thoughts after about a year and a half of using it:
Pros:
- SUPER light. I have quite literally forgotten that I'm wearing it at certain points in time. In fact, I've gotten so used to how light this one is, that my other headsets feel like I'm wearing bricks on my ears. Compared to my JBL Quantum headset, this feels like air.
- Sound quality is amazing. I thought it might be iffy, since there aren't coverings over the speakers, but goodness is it good. It provides excellent surround sound and can be VERY loud.
- It uses both lightspeed USB AND Bluetooth. By simply holding the mute button, I can switch between my PC and my phone without issue.
- Excellent battery life. Considering how much I use it, I thought the battery would be worn down by now, but nope. It lasts at least a solid 12 hours straight, constant sound. I haven't timed it full charge to death, though.
- Actually looks pretty sleek. I don't look like a total doofus while wearing it, just a little like a doofus.
Cons:
- The only big gripe I have is the microphone. It says it has the whole "dual-mic" system going, but it doesn't really work as advertised. It is supposed to be able to cancel out background noise and ONLY detect your voice or close voices, but my buddies say that they can hear EVERYTHING that happens around me. Even small noises like someone coughing across the room.
- Not noise cancelling, but you shouldn't expect that at this price.
Overall, this headset is amazing. I bought it 50% but would definitely pay full price for it again. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: raelink07

reviews.author: JB

reviews.title: Amazing value for wireless/Bluetooth features
reviews.comment:
Excellent headset for price ( on sale $40ish). I was initially worried about all the talk about it being meant for small heads. Rest assured this is NOT an issue, as I have a large head with thick dread locks and this fits perfect! I can barely feel it on my head, that’s how light they are, without them feeling cheap. They are ultra durable being able to twist them to the max with no give.
As for the sound, it’s really great. It has decent bass for watching movies and tv and I have not experienced and distortion with both.
As far as gaming: I primarily game with these on and have no issue with hearing footsteps or my teammates in Cs2, COD, and Siege.
Mic quality: After hearing some mic test online I was initially worried how my voice would sound in discord due to previous having a msi headset with a good warm mic. Although it dosent compare to that mic, my teammates can hear me clearly without distortion and only took my usual friends to get used to the change in my voice very quickly .
I definitely recommend these and this will become my daily gaming headphones and I plan on buying a new pair once these give out.
+++ Logitech software is NOT needed for these headsets which is a win for me because I have had issues with that software in the past.
It also can be connected to your pc or console through a included dongle , as well as connect via Bluetooth , which is amazing I can have these on and swap back and forth from DIFFRENT connections
Overall 4/5 stars easy recommend
reviews.author: Juwan

reviews.title: deceptive in a good way
reviews.comment: this headset is very deceptive because when you open the box and take them out they feel cheaply made BUT once you put them on and connect them to your PC you realize they are supposed to feel like your not wearing anything and the padding around the ears are great... i get no ear fatigue at all even after hours of gaming, the mic quality is "ok" it could be better but its certainly not bad and i wish the battery lasted abit longer but those are my only gripes other than that its a great headset for the price, there have been times where i even forget i have them on and walk outside and the bluetooth range on these is incredible... the sound quality is also stellar i would for sure recommend these if your a casual gamer or take gaming seriously
reviews.author: Adam Aiello

reviews.title: Meh, you can find better.
reviews.comment: Not great sound quality, not great mic quality, noise cancellation? Yeah not really. It has a hard time switching between other headphones --> I have to fiddle with the PC settings to get it to switch. It is fairly comfortable and the battery life is MUCH better than my last pair. You get what you pay for I guess? The last pair was $30 and the sound quality and it cancelled background sounds MUCH better. This was $50 plus and its just not great. Also very light, which could be a good thing? But they end up feeling flimsy. They're fine.
